recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（側散射 SS 對 CD7），非形態影像；閘門內 98.66% 的細胞為 CD7 陽性，主要藍色族群 CD7 表現強（約 10^2），符合 T-PLL 常見的 CD7 強陽性。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD7-APC700 (x-axis, log) versus side scatter intensity (y-axis, linear), gate labeled [AZ]
Rectangular region annotated CD7+ : 98.66% of gated events
Dominant blue population with low side scatter (below about 250) and bright CD7 expression centred near 10^2
Smaller red, magenta and green subsets with dimmer CD7 extending toward the negative region
Small green/magenta CD7-negative population with low side scatter at the left
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot shows CD7 expression versus side scatter within the gated population. Nearly all gated events (98.66%) fall within the CD7-positive region, with the dominant low side scatter population (blue) expressing bright CD7, while a minor population shows dim to negative CD7. The low side scatter indicates lymphoid cells without cytoplasmic granularity. Strong CD7 expression on an expanded T-cell population is characteristic of T-prolymphocytic leukemia and helps distinguish it from Sezary syndrome and ATLL, which usually lose CD7.
